annotations.title: Email a code to see my applications

description: Emails a 6-digit code to a candidate who wants to see the status of their own job applications at Modulos. The status is private: use only the email address of the person you are assisting, the one they applied with. The answer is the same whether or not the address has applications; a code arrives only if it has. Ask the candidate for the code, then call get_application_status with it. For any issue, the candidate can write to jobs@modulos.ai.

email.description: Email address the candidate applied with. The code is sent there.

name: request_application_status_code
